name: Blinding Spray
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to disable the blade that bursts the bladder

items.name: No Orphans Allowed
items.text:
Trigger The door is opened

---
Effect The powder sprays in a burst that fills the square in front of the door and all adjacent squares in the orphans' dormitory. Any creature in the area must attempt a DC 21 Reflex save save.

---
Success The creature is Dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 minute.

text: A bladder of powdered peppers is secreted in a compartment above the door.
